title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts: Parts Allowance When a Waiting-Period Denial Is Re-decided
content:
On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the parts reimbursed are set by how the store charged the covered parts. These are the store's customer-pay parts lines on the concern line of the repair order that carries its diagnostic fee, as recorded in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

- **Parts charged below list:** the parts reimbursed are the parts actually charged.
- **Parts charged at list, with a goodwill credit given on the covered concern line:** the parts reimbursed are the list amount less that goodwill credit.
- **Otherwise:** the parts reimbursed are the list amount.

| Parts list total | Parts charged | Goodwill credit on the concern line | Parts reimbursed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 512.40 | 486.78 | — | 486.78 |
| 512.40 | 512.40 | 60.00 | 452.40 |
| 512.40 | 512.40 | none | 512.40 |
| 512.40 | 486.78 | 60.00 | 486.78 (charged below list, so the first case governs) |

The figures in the table are hypothetical. Parts charged exactly at the list total count as charged at list.
